text: I had a walk around the Terarium, and there were\nSO MANY Pokémon I’d never seen before![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: I thought about this a lot in Kitakami, too—it’s so\ncool seein’ unfamiliar Pokémon just living their\r\nlives as they do in nature![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Reading about ’em in textbooks can’t hold a\ncandle to seeing ’em for real, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: It’s so real this way!

label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_04
text: Though, come to think of it, I guess there was a\ntime when even the wild Pokémon of Paldea were\r\nbrand-new to me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: I actually moved to Paldea when I was seven.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: coach_paldea_rival_sp02_07
